_comment: Frame pacing for an overlay that runs all day (master plan Phase 11). The animations run at 12 frames per second at most, so idle and battery rates below that level cost nothing visible; moving_fps covers the seconds when Caramelo is hopping between anchors or dissolving from one pose into the next, which are eased and want real frames. 'idle' means no pointer over the window and no open window for idle_after_seconds.
